purpose: Locate the failed file-probe boundary, apply an evidence-based repair, then verify the fixed lifecycle
probes: fixed marker write and initial read
known original deletion and static absence plus durable receipt
diagnostics: Fixed enums/numeric status/elapsed/counts only; no raw errors, URLs, headers, bodies, tokens or provider text
admission: One fresh original journal/input/source/account/quote binding per approved operation; prior terminal verified before another. Unknown or failed cleanup stops the series. At most3 original creates across the series, no retries of an uncertain create.
repairs: Follow canonical recorded design; preserve original source/operation/evidence, rerun relevant checks before any revised execution; do not guess or weaken security
cleanup: Always attempt original-only static inspect/delete; never resume for cleanup. Verified absence and durable terminal receipt before slot release.
peer_review: clear; independent86 native/core cases and strict adapter types
